description: Land Acquisition - Thalagala, Beruketiya & Moragahahena Villages, Horana D/S Division, Kaluthara District
categorisation: This gazette content is a land acquisition notice under the Land Acquisition Act, declaring that specific parcels of land are needed for a public purpose. It provides detailed descriptions of multiple land lots, including their extents, boundaries, and claimants. The content is exclusively focused on land matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land acquisitions and property-related administrative actions.
